purpose_context: An org pack authored in the canonical drg/fragment.yaml shape can declare that activating one artifact should cascade to its dependencies. Today those edges are parsed only by a separate diagnostic path and never reach charter cascade, so activating the artifact silently cascades nothing for org-authored dependencies. This mission bridges the org fragment edges into the graph charter cascade actually walks, re-scopes the graphless-pack warning to fire only when a pack ships no dependency graph at all, and flips the validator and the pinning regression test together so the tool's story stays consistent.
purpose_tldr: Dependency edges an org pack declares in its canonical fragment now actually drive charter cascade, instead of being read only by diagnostics.
